name: Educational Explain
description: Structured explainer format — hook, intro, 3 clear points, conclusion. Best for educational content, how things work, concept breakdowns, and 'here's what you need to know' content.
voice_style: clear, engaging, slightly faster than normal speech — confident teacher energy; pauses after key points for visual beats
music_mood: upbeat acoustic, clean electronic, study beats — present but not overpowering narration

scene_sequence.narration_prompt: You have been using this wrong your entire life. Here's the right way — and it takes 30 seconds.
scene_sequence.visual_prompt: Person looking confused, close-up of hands doing task incorrectly, X mark appearing, then question face switching to lightbulb moment, bold text 'YOU'RE DOING IT WRONG'
scene_sequence.camera_movement: static close-up on confused face, cut to hands close-up doing wrong method, cut to lightbulb moment
scene_sequence.lighting_setup: neutral studio key light for face clarity, accent light on hands, high contrast for X mark graphic
scene_sequence.hailuo_style_note: Confusion-to-clarity arc is the format hook; make the 'wrong' method look genuinely wrong with visual cues

scene_sequence.narration_prompt: In this video I'm breaking down exactly how it works, why the common approach fails, and the exact method used by experts. Let's go.
scene_sequence.visual_prompt: Person pointing at camera introducing topic, graphic showing '3 KEY POINTS' appearing, whiteboard or digital diagram in background, clean modern setting
scene_sequence.camera_movement: medium close-up direct address, subtle pan toward diagram in background, return to camera
scene_sequence.lighting_setup: clean two-point lighting, key from above-right, fill from left, bright and academic feel
scene_sequence.hailuo_style_note: Clean academic aesthetic builds trust; the '3 KEY POINTS' graphic should be bold and scannable instantly

scene_sequence.narration_prompt: Point one: Most people skip this step entirely. But it's the foundation everything else builds on. Without it, nothing else works.
scene_sequence.visual_prompt: Number '1' appearing large on screen, diagram building step by step, person explaining with hand gestures, graphic animation of foundation being laid
scene_sequence.camera_movement: medium shot with graphic overlay appearing in frame, steady hold during diagram animation
scene_sequence.lighting_setup: blue accent on diagram elements, warm skin tones, animated graphic glow effect
scene_sequence.hailuo_style_note: Diagram animation is shareable on its own; number '1' should be large and bold, brand-colored

scene_sequence.narration_prompt: Point two: Here's where most people give up. But if you push through this specific barrier, you unlock the compound effect — everything accelerates from here.
scene_sequence.visual_prompt: Number '2' appearing, graph going up steeply, person at turning point moment, upward arrow animation, mountain climbing metaphor visual
scene_sequence.camera_movement: medium shot, slight tilt up to match upward energy of the metaphor, hold on steep graph
scene_sequence.lighting_setup: warmer tones for breakthrough energy, slight lens flare on upward arrow, triumphant feeling
scene_sequence.hailuo_style_note: Breakthrough point deserves the energy bump — warmer color, upward camera tilt, and the graph animation should be satisfying

scene_sequence.narration_prompt: Point three: This is the habit that separates the top 10% from everyone else. It's simple. Most people know it. Almost no one actually does it consistently.
scene_sequence.visual_prompt: Number '3' appearing, checkmark appearing over consistent habit, person on couch vs person taking action side-by-side comparison, discipline graphic
scene_sequence.camera_movement: cut between two side-by-side scenes (couch vs action), balanced composition for contrast
scene_sequence.lighting_setup: dim gray tones for 'couch' scene, bright warm tones for 'action' scene — lighting IS the contrast
scene_sequence.hailuo_style_note: Lighting-as-contrast is subtle but powerful; viewers feel the difference before you even explain it

scene_sequence.narration_prompt: Three points: foundation, breakthrough, habit. That's it. That's the whole framework.
scene_sequence.visual_prompt: All three points appearing together as a framework diagram, person summarizing, clean summary graphic, numbers 1-2-3 connected
scene_sequence.camera_movement: static medium close-up with graphic overlay, confident summary delivery
scene_sequence.lighting_setup: clean bright key light, all three numbers glowing in brand colors
scene_sequence.hailuo_style_note: Clean framework diagram is highly save-worthy; the 'that's it' delivery should feel confident and complete

scene_sequence.narration_prompt: Follow for more explainers like this. Drop a comment — what topic should I break down next?
scene_sequence.visual_prompt: Person pointing at follow button, comment section preview, person smiling at camera, 'FOLLOW' text pulsing
scene_sequence.camera_movement: medium close-up, warm friendly direct address
scene_sequence.lighting_setup: warm inviting light, friendly energy, slight lens flare
scene_sequence.hailuo_style_note: Warm and genuine — educational creators build loyalty through consistency; CTA should feel like inviting a friend
